description: Source code for the abstract class MonkeyMotionEvent, which models motion events in the Android Monkey testing tool, including methods for constructing and injecting MotionEvent objects.

classes.name: MonkeyMotionEvent
classes.description: Abstract class representing motion events in the Android Monkey testing framework, providing methods to build, configure, and inject motion events.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a pointer with specified id, x, y, pressure, and size to the motion event.

methods.name: setIntermediateNote
methods.description: Sets whether this event is an intermediate step for verbose logging.

methods.name: getIntermediateNote
methods.description: Returns whether this event is marked as an intermediate note.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action type of the motion event.

methods.name: getDownTime
methods.description: Returns the down time of the event.

methods.name: setDownTime
methods.description: Sets the down time for the event.

methods.name: setMetaState
methods.description: Sets the meta state for the motion event.

methods.name: setPrecision
methods.description: Sets the x and y precision for the motion event.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID for the motion event.

methods.name: setEdgeFlags
methods.description: Sets the edge flags for the motion event.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Constructs and returns an Android MotionEvent object based on the current state.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Determines if the event can be throttled, based on whether the action is ACTION_UP.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the constructed MotionEvent into the system via InputManager, with verbose logging.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Abstract method to return a string label for the type of motion event.
